scope: Prespecified bounded gas-side operation comparison for unchanged selected-shelf STL; no biological safety or activation target.

targets.status: Provisional engineering comparison targets declared before new results; not user-confirmed and not biological injury thresholds.

selection_rule: Select the smallest sampled Q satisfying all declared constraints across four wells and all three assumed Dgas values. If no Q qualifies, return no selection. Publish nondominated worst-case gas t90 versus gas P95 speed without weighted scores. Dgas is an uncertain material property, not an adjustable operating knob.
model: Gas-only conservative FV with prescribed steady Stokes-scaled saved velocity, impermeable liquid surface. No membrane or liquid uptake.
validation_plan: Q5/D10 dx0.3 and dt0.125 checks; Q0.25/D10 dt0.5 check; direct near5mLmin velocity solve on dx0.3/tau0.55 compared against existing near1mLmin solution, plus scalar on the direct field.
